messages:
nina: Heads up  new changelog draft ready for review: https://redwood.internal/docs/changelog-2223. Focus areas: Go + Rust SDK snippets, migration guide for cached KV behavior, and Known Issues. Need thumbs before EOD.

chris: I'll vet the Go snippets. Noting a signature change in go-sdk: `Generate` now returns a stream interface, small API tweak.

lee: I'll check the Rust examples and run linkcheck. Also can add a tiny migration note for KV cache TTL change.

docs-ci-bot: Linkcheck report for branch release/2223: 3 items flagged -> /examples/old-go-snippet, broken anchor /guides/kv-cache#ttl, image URL 404. CI job #447.

chris: Replacing /examples/old-go-snippet with /examples/go/generate-stream. Adding example showing stream consumption. PR 1407 opened.

lee: Fixing anchor and image reference. For KV cache TTL change I'll add: "Default prefix cache TTL reduced from 60s to 10s; if you rely on long-lived prefixes, set `cache.prefix_ttl` explicitly." Adding short migration CLI + Rust snippet.

ana: UX nit: Known Issues should include pointer about model fallback during failover  users may see short output truncation if model fallback triggers. Suggest minimal troubleshooting steps.

nina: Good call. Keep it compact: bullet with symptom, quick mitigation (pin model version + increase timeout), and link to runbook.

chris: Added Go streaming snippet and a fallback example:
```go
cli := redwood.New()
stream := cli.GenerateStream(ctx, opts)
for chunk := range stream.Chunks() {
  fmt.Print(chunk.Text)
}
```
and a one-liner to revert to non-streaming: `cli.Generate(ctx, opts).Blocking()`

lee: Rust snippet added and anchor fixed. Also replaced the broken image with alt text and filed issue #947 for the missing asset. PR 1410 -> docs changes + migration blurb.

docs-ci-bot: Re-run linkcheck: all links green except image ticketed as issue #947.

release-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging 18:10 UTC, prod window 23:45 UTC.

nina: Looks good to me. Merging in 10 unless objections. Tagging PRs 1407 and 1410 and follow-up issue #947.

chris: LGTM :thumbsup: Will update Go SDK changelog to call out stream return type change.

lee: Merged. I'll validate staging after deploy and confirm anchors.

nina: Thanks everyone, will post final changelog copy to #product once prod is live.
